name: Generic transit bus
description: Generic unbranded 40 ft low-floor transit bus, 12.2 x 2.59 x 3.10 m, wheelbase 7.2 m, two-tone (Paint upper, Trim lower), dual rear wheels. Paint is near-white for scene tinting. LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 groups plus Wheel_FL/FR/RL/RR nodes. Revision 2: closed the open back. The rear and front end caps of the Paint loft (and of the LOD2 Paint and Trim lofts) were wound inward and culled by the single-sided viewer; addLoft now derives the cap direction from the station order. Geometry, triangle counts, materials, dimensions and LOD structure are otherwise unchanged.
brief: Review 2 fix: the transit bus was see-through from behind at every LOD. Close the rear body face with body Paint, keep the taillights, plate panel and bounds, and leave other vehicles, materials, dimensions and LOD structure unchanged.
